title: Yaroslav and Arrangements
statementMd:
Yaroslav calls an array of $*r*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*r*}$ *good*, if it meets the following conditions: $|*a*_{1} - *a*_{2}| = 1, |*a*_{2} - *a*_{3}| = 1, ..., |*a*_{*r* - 1} - *a*_{*r*}| = 1, |*a*_{*r*} - *a*_{1}| = 1$, at that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8a6eafe51332353e0444f709fbbb17f1629560b.png).

An array of integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*r*}$ is called *great*, if it meets the following conditions:

1. The elements in it do not decrease $(*b*_{*i*} ≤ *b*_{*i* + 1})$.
2. If the inequalities $1 ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$ and $1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$ hold.
3. If we can rearrange its elements and get at least one and at most $*k*$ distinct good arrays.

Yaroslav has three integers $*n*, *m*, *k*$. He needs to count the number of distinct great arrays. Help Yaroslav! As the answer may be rather large, print the remainder after dividing it by $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$.

Two arrays are considered distinct if there is a position in which they have distinct numbers.

## Input

The single line contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$, $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m*, *k* ≤ 100)$.

## Output

In a single line print the remainder after dividing the answer to the problem by number $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$.
statementZhMd:
Yaroslav 将一个由 $*r*$ 个整数组成的数组 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*r*}$ 称为*好数组*，当且仅当它满足以下条件：$|*a*_{1} - *a*_{2}| = 1, |*a*_{2} - *a*_{3}| = 1, ..., |*a*_{*r* - 1} - *a*_{*r*}| = 1, |*a*_{*r*} - *a*_{1}| = 1$，此时 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8a6eafe51332353e0444f709fbbb17f1629560b.png)。

如果一个由整数组成的数组 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*r*}$ 满足以下条件，则称其为*优秀数组*：

1. 其中的元素不递减（$*b*_{*i*} ≤ *b*_{*i* + 1}$）。
2. 满足不等式 $1 ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$ 和 $1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$。
3. 可以重新排列其中的元素，得到至少一个且至多 $*k*$ 个不同的好数组。

Yaroslav 有三个整数 $*n*, *m*, *k*$。他需要计算优秀数组的不同数量。请帮助 Yaroslav！由于答案可能很大，请输出其除以 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）所得的余数。

如果存在某个位置上的数字不同，则认为两个数组不同。

## 输入

一行包含三个整数 $*n*, *m*, *k*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m*, *k* ≤ 100$）。

## 输出

一行输出答案除以 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）所得的余数。
